query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.title,
  p.year,
  p.client,
  p.location,
  p.excerpt,
  GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ' | ') as current_tags,
  COUNT(pt.tagId) as tag_count
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
LEFT JOIN tags t ON pt.tagId = t.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.year, p.client, p.location, p.excerpt
HAVING tag_count < 5
ORDER BY p.year DESC, p.title;

rows.title: The Northwind Mare Tavern
rows.excerpt: A fantasy tavern emerges from twilight mist—carved horse-head gables, glowing lanterns, stone walls weathered by imagined centuries. Emberreach invites guests into a Tamriel-inspired realm where dining becomes adventure, and every detail whispers of distant quests and fireside tales.

rows.title: Urinetown
rows.excerpt: Explore the innovative scenic design of Urinetown, a satirical musical that cleverly tackles a dystopian water shortage. Discover how visuals enhance storytelling!

rows.title: ¡LOTERIA: GAME ON!
rows.excerpt: ¡Lotería: Game On! is the world premiere of a bilingual play by Mabelle Reynoso, directed by Sara Rodriguez. The scenic design transforms a familiar suburban basement living room into a vibrant, game-driven world inspired by Lotería, video games, and imaginative play, blending physical scenery, projection, and dynamic lighting to support a fast-moving theatrical experience.

rows.title: Boeing, Boeing
rows.excerpt: Scenic design for Marc Camoletti's French farce about an American architect juggling three stewardess fiancées.

rows.title: Head Over Heels
rows.excerpt: Explore the vibrant scenic design of "Head Over Heels," the jukebox musical that celebrates The Go-Go's. Uncover creativity and inspiration behind the stage!

rows.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
rows.excerpt: Scenic design for the Sondheim musical comedy set in ancient Rome.

rows.title: An Inspector Calls
rows.excerpt: Explore the captivating scenic design of J.B. Priestley's "An Inspector Calls" and discover how it enhances this gripping moral thriller on class and responsibility.

rows.title: The Merry Wives of Windsor
rows.excerpt: Scenic design for Shakespeare's comedy set in Windsor, England.

rows.title: Tomás and the Library Lady
rows.excerpt: Explore the vibrant scenic design of "Tomás and the Library Lady," a bilingual play that celebrates literacy and the transformative power of libraries.

rows.title: Ashes of the Underworld
rows.excerpt: A liminal space between life and death, inspired by The Penelopiad. Grecian ruins decay among lifeless trees while fire burns eternal. Created during pandemic isolation in Chicago, when artists found themselves suspended between the theatre that was and whatever might come next.

rows.title: Isolation
rows.excerpt: Set in a quiet, imagined interior, this rendering explores themes of isolation, distance, and the weight of solitude. A contemplative space where architecture becomes emotion, and emptiness speaks volumes.

rows.title: New Swan Venue File
rows.excerpt: Complete Vectorworks venue file for the New Swan Theatre, documenting the outdoor performance space with technical precision. A digital archive of architectural detail and theatrical infrastructure.

rows.title: The Penelopiad
rows.excerpt: Explore the innovative scenic design of Margaret Atwood's The Penelopiad, a captivating retelling of The Odyssey from Penelope's unique perspective.

rows.title: Company
rows.excerpt: Explore the captivating scenic design of Sondheim's musical, showcasing the complexities of marriage and relationships in vibrant New York City.

rows.title: Parliament Square
rows.excerpt: Explore the stunning theatrical and scenic design of Parliament Square. Discover its history, artistry, and how it enhances the cultural landscape.

rows.title: The Pajama Game
rows.excerpt: Explore the vibrant scenic design of "The Pajama Game," a 1950s musical comedy that masterfully intertwines labor relations and romance. Discover more!

rows.title: American Idiot
rows.excerpt: Explore the stunning scenic design of the Green Day rock musical "American Idiot." Discover how innovative visuals enhance this powerful theatrical experience.

rows.title: Angel Food Cake
rows.excerpt: A mobile home interior for the West Coast premiere of Angel Food Cake at Western Summer Theatre. Plaid upholstery, red-checkered backsplash, wood-paneled walls—everyday space holding extraordinary emotional weight. The home itself becomes a character.

rows.title: Angel Street
rows.excerpt: Explore the captivating scenic design of "Angel Street," Patrick Hamilton's Victorian thriller. Discover how visual elements enhance this gripping Gaslight tale!

rows.title: All My Sons
rows.excerpt: Discover the scenic design of All My Sons, showcasing the idealized postwar American Dream with a charming home, inviting porch, and expansive backyard.
